wave_2_cross_project_models.major_conclusion: Still center can be zero collective drift while differentiated internal dynamics remain active; integration metrics must be chosen for the relation being organized, not only for sameness.

Garden versus Farm is scientifically strongest as an objective/control/outcome distinction; identical network topology can support cultivation or capture depending on reinvestment, constraints and durable peripheral capability.

Visibility, radiant energy, attention, information gain, evidence quality and causality are distinct coordinates; Spudlight's scientific value is the typed conversion chain rather than a presumed universal light substance.
Physical North is frame-dependent; celestial alignment is an angular residual that can return a negative result; one remembered torus length cannot identify a two-radius torus.
Science is now a project-wide translation layer: each major symbol can ask a calculable question without being reduced to the scientific comparator.

substantive_conclusions: The project's strongest scientific integration is compositional: models connect through typed interfaces, not by putting every scientific noun in one Lagrangian.

The most useful scientific formalization often distinguishes coordinates that prose had collapsed: compactness vs curvature; phase vs scale; mean vs relative motion; visibility vs information; support vs autonomous capability; symbolic North vs astronomical vector.

A scientific model should be allowed to produce a negative result. The Sirius/Regulus physical-North sanity check is valuable precisely because it does not force symbolic correspondence into physical collinearity.
A center is scientifically meaningful by what it does to trajectories, capability and observability, not by the title 'center'. Different centralities and control roles must remain separate.
Integration without flattening now has a mathematical example: an anti-phase pair can be highly ordered while the ordinary in-phase order parameter is zero.
Garden becomes measurable when cultivation leaves durable capability after support is reduced; activity during dependence is a weaker test.
Spudlight becomes measurable when a source state passes through a declared channel into observations that change justified inference or prediction.
Coordinate frames, unit registries and uncertainty are not bookkeeping; they decide whether two quantities can meaningfully be compared at all.
